summary: Join our expert-led training course to learn how to draft clear and enforceable service contracts. Elevate your contract skills for professional success.
lede: Service contract drafting helps procurement, legal, contract, project, finance, and operations professionals define clear provider obligations. It covers setting scopes and measurable deliverables, establishing timelines and acceptance criteria, and connecting payments and service levels to performance. Participants also practise managing changes, risks, remedies, and post-signature performance so responsibilities and expectations are documented.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who draft, review, approve, manage, or enforce service contracts. It's tailored for those who want to reduce surprises, prevent disputes, and strengthen protection through clear contracting.
modules: Service Contract Fundamentals and Why Clarity Wins
Structuring a Service Contract for Real-World Use
Drafting a Clear Scope of Work
Pricing, Payments, and Contract Value Control
Variations, Change Control, and Scope Creep Management
Service Levels, KPIs, and Performance Remedies
Risk, Liability, and Indemnities Without Legal Confusion
Confidentiality, Data Protection, and Intellectual Property
Contract Management Handover and Post-Signature Control
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of contract law and experience in drafting or managing service contracts. Familiarity with basic legal terms is recommended but not required.
